description: This file defines the Migration class for Drupal's migrate module, implementing migration plugin functionality including configuration, dependencies, status management, and plugin instantiation.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a migration plugin in Drupal's migrate module, managing configuration, dependencies, status, and plugin instantiation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the Migration plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label of the migration.

methods.name: getIdMapPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves the ID map plugin instance.

methods.name: getSourcePlugin
methods.description: Initializes and returns the source plugin instance.

methods.name: getProcessPlugins
methods.description: Returns processed plugin instances for the migration process.

methods.name: getProcessNormalized
methods.description: Normalizes process configuration shorthands into plugin configurations.

methods.name: getDestinationPlugin
methods.description: Returns the destination plugin instance, optionally as a stub.

methods.name: getIdMap
methods.description: Returns the ID map plugin instance.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Returns the list of requirements for the migration.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks if source, destination, and dependencies meet requirements.

methods.name: getMigrationPluginManager
methods.description: Returns the migration plugin manager.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the migration.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the migration.

methods.name: getStatusLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the current status.

methods.name: getInterruptionResult
methods.description: Gets the result of an interrupted migration.

methods.name: clearInterruptionResult
methods.description: Clears the interruption result.

methods.name: interruptMigration
methods.description: Marks the migration as stopping and records the result.

methods.name: allRowsProcessed
methods.description: Checks if all source rows have been processed.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value, invalidating related plugins if necessary.

methods.name: getProcess
methods.description: Returns the normalized process configuration.

methods.name: setProcess
methods.description: Sets the process configuration.

methods.name: setProcessOfProperty
methods.description: Sets process configuration for a specific property.

methods.name: addRequiredDependencies
methods.description: Adds migration IDs to required dependencies.

methods.name: addOptionalDependencies
methods.description: Adds migration IDs to optional dependencies.

methods.name: mergeProcessOfProperty
methods.description: Merges new process configuration into existing for a property.

methods.name: getMigrationDependencies
methods.description: Returns the migration dependencies, with deprecation warning for $expand parameter.

methods.name: findMigrationDependencies
methods.description: Recursively finds migration dependencies from process plugins.

methods.name: getPluginDefinition
methods.description: Returns the plugin definition, including dynamic properties.

methods.name: getDestinationConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the destination plugin configuration.

methods.name: getSourceConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the source plugin configuration.

methods.name: getDestinationIds
methods.description: Returns destination identifiers.

methods.name: getMigrationTags
methods.description: Returns migration tags.

methods.name: isAuditable
methods.description: Indicates if the migration is auditable.
